summary: The diff implements a user profile system with Internet Identity authentication. A ProfileSetupDialog was added to collect user names after authentication, and the admin authentication flow was enhanced to check user profiles and admin roles. The Header now displays the authenticated user's name. However, the diff does not show evidence of implementing the core requirements: homepage with Arabic branding (REQ-1), services table page (REQ-2), backend service APIs (REQ-3), admin service/order management (REQ-4), order placement system (REQ-5), or visual design theme (REQ-7). The diff appears to be a small incremental change focused on user profile management rather than a comprehensive implementation of the BuildRequest.
